title: Collection by Offset from VA Benefit Payments (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery)
content:
## Rule

VA collects an active debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** by withholding the debt type's offset share of each Disability Compensation, Veterans Pension or education payment listed among the debt type's offset benefit lines, never more than the remaining balance.

1. **Start of withholding.** Withholding from a benefit payment begins only for payments issued not earlier than the debt type's offset start period, in calendar days, after the date of the initial debt notice. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice date; a payment issued on the last day of the period is subject to offset. The clock starts on the notice date shown on the debt record, and the comparison is not-earlier-than: a payment issued on the last day qualifies.
2. **Status.** Benefit offset is applied only to a debt whose status is active or repayment plan.
3. **Reduced withholding.** Under a reduced-withholding plan, each monthly benefit payment is withheld only the approved monthly amount, but a retroactive benefit release is still offset up to the full balance where the debt type's retroactive-release term is Yes.
4. **No offset.** A debt that is on hold, referred to Treasury, or whose debtor has died is not offset from VA benefits.

Both the notice date and the status are read from the system's debt record, not from the debtor's account of events.

## Boundary cases (abstract dates)

Take the notice date as Day 0 and the debt type's offset start period as N calendar days; Day 1 is the day after the notice.

| Benefit payment issued on | Subject to offset |
|---|---|
| Day N minus 1 | No — issued earlier than N days after the notice |
| Day N, the last day of the period | Yes |
| Any day after Day N | Yes |

## Status check

| Debt status | Benefit offset applied |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Repayment plan | Yes — the approved monthly amount under reduced withholding; a retroactive release up to the full balance where that term is Yes |
| On hold | No |
| Referred to Treasury | No |
| Debtor has died | No |
